en.t: The city of Melite surrenders to an Aghlabid army following a siege, putting an end to Byzantine Malta
en.s: The siege of Melite was the capture of the Byzantine city of Melite (modern Mdina, Malta) by an invading Aghlabid army in 870 AD. The siege was initially led by Halaf al-Hādim, a renowned engineer, but he was killed and replaced by Sawāda Ibn Muḥammad. The city withstood the siege for some weeks or months, but it ultimately fell to the invaders, and its inhabitants were massacred and the city was sacked.

zh.t: 围城后，梅利特城向阿格拉布军队投降，拜占庭对马耳他的统治结束
zh.s: 梅利特围城战是公元870年入侵的阿格拉布军队攻占拜占庭城市梅利特（今马耳他姆迪纳）的战役。围城最初由著名工程师哈拉夫·哈迪姆指挥；他阵亡后，萨瓦达·伊本·穆罕默德接替指挥。该城抵抗了数周或数月，最终仍被入侵者攻陷；居民遭到屠杀，城市被洗劫。

en.s: The battle of Fāriskūr was a pitched battle fought between the army of the Fifth Crusade and Ayyubid Egypt on 29 August 1219 outside the Ayyubid encampment at Fāriskūr. It was fought while the siege of Damietta was ongoing. An Ayyubid victory, it had little effect on the course of the war.

zh.s: 1219年8月29日，第五次十字军东征的军队与阿尤布王朝的埃及军队在法里斯库尔的阿尤布军营外展开一场激战。当时达米埃塔围城战仍在进行。阿尤布军获胜，但这场战斗对战争进程影响不大。

en.s: The Battle of Montecatini was fought in the Val di Nievole on August 29, 1315 between the Republic of Pisa, and the forces of both the Kingdom of Naples and the Republic of Florence. The army of Pisa, commanded by Uguccione della Faggiuola, won a decisive victory despite being outnumbered. The Neapolitan forces, made up of nearly 60,000 men, were commanded by Philip I of Taranto. While he survived the battle, his eldest son Charles of Taranto and his brother Peter, Count of Eboli and Gravina, were both killed in the fight.

zh.s: 1315年8月29日，比萨共和国与那不勒斯王国、佛罗伦萨共和国的联军在涅沃莱河谷交战。乌古乔内·德拉·法焦拉指挥的比萨军队虽处于劣势，仍取得决定性胜利。那不勒斯军队约有6万人，由塔兰托的腓力一世指挥。腓力在战斗中幸存，但其长子塔兰托的查理和兄弟埃博利及格拉维纳伯爵彼得均战死。

en.s: The Battle of Les Espagnols sur Mer ("the Spaniards on the Sea"), or the Battle of Winchelsea, was a naval battle that took place on 29 August 1350 and was a victory for an English fleet of 50 ships commanded by Edward III, with the Black Prince, over a combined Castilian and Genoese fleet of 44 much larger vessels commanded by Don Carlos de la Cerda. Between 14 and 26 Castilian ships were captured, and some were sunk, while 2 English vessels were sunk and many suffered heavy losses.

zh.s: 1350年8月29日，英格兰舰队与卡斯蒂利亚—热那亚联军在海上交战。这场海战也称“海上的西班牙人”之战或温切尔西海战。爱德华三世和黑太子指挥的50艘英格兰舰艇击败了唐·卡洛斯·德·拉塞尔达率领的44艘更大型舰艇。英军俘获了14至26艘卡斯蒂利亚船只，另有一些被击沉；英军有2艘船被击沉，许多船只也遭受重创。

en.s: The English invasion of Scotland in August 1400 was the first military campaign undertaken by Henry IV of England after deposing the previous king, his cousin Richard II. Henry IV urgently wanted to defend the Anglo-Scottish border, and to overcome his predecessor's legacy of failed military campaigns. A successful campaign against the Scots would also heighten his own image as a strong ruler and reinforce the new regime.

zh.s: 1400年8月，英格兰国王亨利四世废黜堂弟理查二世后，首次发动军事行动，入侵苏格兰。亨利四世急于守住英苏边境，并扭转前任多次军事行动失败的局面。他希望通过对苏格兰作战获胜，树立强势统治者的形象并巩固新政权。

en.s: The Treaty of Picquigny was a peace treaty negotiated on 29 August 1475 between the Kingdom of England and the Kingdom of France. It followed from an invasion of France by Edward IV of England in alliance with Burgundy and Brittany. It left Louis XI of France free to solve the threat posed by Charles the Bold, Duke of Burgundy.

zh.s: 英格兰王国和法兰西王国于1475年8月29日谈判缔结皮基尼和约。此前，英格兰国王爱德华四世联合勃艮第和布列塔尼入侵法国。条约使法国国王路易十一得以专心应对勃艮第公爵“大胆查理”带来的威胁。

en.s: The Battle of Azemmour took place in Morocco, on 28 and 29 August 1513 between the Portuguese Empire and the Moroccan Wattasid dynasty. Azemmour, dependent on the King of Fes, even enjoying of great autonomy, paid vassalage to the king João II of Portugal since 1486. The disagreements generated with the governor Moulay Zayam, who refused to pay tribute to Manuel I of Portugal and prepared an army to defend itself, caused King Manuel to send a fleet to that city on 15 August 1513. On 1 September the Portuguese army, led by James, Duke of Braganza, took the city without resistance.

zh.s: 阿泽穆尔战役于1513年8月28日至29日在摩洛哥爆发，交战双方是葡萄牙帝国和摩洛哥瓦塔斯王朝。阿泽穆尔隶属非斯国王，但享有很大的自治权；自1486年起，该城一直向葡萄牙国王若昂二世称臣。由于总督穆莱·扎扬拒绝向葡萄牙国王曼努埃尔一世纳贡，并着手组织军队自卫，曼努埃尔国王于1513年8月15日派遣舰队前往该城。9月1日，由布拉干萨公爵海梅率领的葡萄牙军队未遇抵抗便占领了该城。

Ottoman Sultan Suleiman the Magnificent launched his army in mid-May 1521. The Hungarian state was almost in disarray and unable to effectively counter the Ottoman army.

en.s: The Battle of Mohács (Hungarian: [ˈmohaːt͡ʃ]; Hungarian: Mohácsi csata, Turkish: Mohaç Muharebesi) was one of the most consequential battles in Central European history. It was fought on 29 August 1526 near Mohács, Kingdom of Hungary, between the forces of the Kingdom of Hungary, led by Louis II, and those of the Ottoman Empire, led by Suleiman the Magnificent. The Ottoman victory led to the partition of Hungary for several centuries between the Ottoman Empire, the Habsburg Monarchy, and the Principality of Transylvania. Further, the death of Louis II as he fled the battle marked the end of the Jagiellon dynasty in Hungary and Bohemia, whose dynastic claims passed to the House of Habsburg.

zh.s: 莫哈奇战役（匈牙利语：Mohácsi csata，土耳其语：Mohaç Muharebesi）是中欧历史上影响深远的战役之一。1526年8月29日，路易二世率领的匈牙利王国军队与苏莱曼大帝率领的奥斯曼帝国军队在匈牙利王国莫哈奇附近交战。奥斯曼军队获胜，匈牙利此后数百年间分裂于奥斯曼帝国、哈布斯堡君主国和特兰西瓦尼亚公国之间。此外，路易二世在逃离战场时身亡，标志着匈牙利和波希米亚的雅盖隆王朝终结，其王位继承主张转归哈布斯堡家族。

en.s: The Ottoman–Habsburg wars were fought from the 16th to the 18th centuries between the Ottoman Empire and the Habsburg monarchy, which was at times supported by the Kingdom of Hungary, Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, the Holy Roman Empire, and Habsburg Spain. The wars were dominated by land campaigns in Hungary, including Transylvania (today in Romania) and Vojvodina (today in Serbia), Croatia, and central Serbia.

en.s: The Raid on Haverhill was a military engagement that took place on August 29, 1708, during Queen Anne's War. French, Algonquin, and Abenaki warriors under the command of Jean-Baptiste Hertel de Rouville descended on Haverhill, then a small frontier community in the Province of Massachusetts Bay. In the surprise attack, 16 people were killed and another 14 to 24 were taken captive.

zh.s: 安妮女王战争期间，1708年8月29日，尚属马萨诸塞湾省的小型边境聚落黑弗里尔遭到突袭。让-巴蒂斯特·埃泰尔·德·鲁维尔率领法国、阿尔冈昆和阿贝纳基战士袭击该地。突袭造成16人死亡，另有14至24人被俘。

en.t: The city of Nuuk in Greenland is founded as the fort of Godt-Haab by the royal governor Claus Paarss
en.s: Nuuk (Greenlandic pronunciation: [nuːk] ; formerly Danish: Godthåb) is the capital and most populous city of Greenland, an autonomous territory of Denmark. It is the seat of the Sermersooq municipality and the government of Greenland and is the territory's largest cultural and economic center. In January 2025, it had a population of 20,113—more than a third of the territory's population—making it one of the smallest capital cities in the world by population.

zh.t: 格陵兰努克市由皇家总督克劳斯·帕尔斯创建，最初是一座名为Godt-Haab的堡垒
zh.s: 努克（格陵兰语发音：[nuːk]；旧称丹麦语：Godthåb）是格陵兰的首府和人口最多的城市；格陵兰是丹麦的自治领地。努克是塞梅尔索克市镇和格陵兰政府所在地，也是该领地最大的文化和经济中心。2025年1月，努克人口为20,113人，超过该领地人口的三分之一；按人口计算，它是世界上规模最小的首都之一。

en.t: The eruption of Oshima–Ōshima and the Kampo tsunami: At least 2,000 people along the Japanese coast drown in a tsunami caused by the eruption of Oshima
en.s: The devastating eruption of Oshima–Ōshima began on 18 August 1741 and ended on 1 May the next year. Eleven days into the eruption, the Kampo tsunami (Japanese: 寛保津波, Hepburn: Kampo tsunami) with estimated maximum heights of 60–90 m (200–300 ft) swept across neighboring islands in Japan and the Korean Peninsula. The eruption and its resulting tsunami killed at least 1,400 people.

en.s: The Battle of Rhode Island (or Battle of Quaker Hill) took place on August 29, 1778. Continental Army and militia forces commanded by Major-General John Sullivan had been on Aquidneck Island besieging British forces occupying Newport, Rhode Island. They chose to lift the siege and planned to withdraw to the northern part of Aquidneck Island. The British then sortied, supported by recently arrived Royal Navy ships, and attacked the retreating Americans.

zh.s: 罗得岛战役也称奎克山战役，发生于1778年8月29日。约翰·沙利文少将率领的大陆军和民兵部队此前一直在阿奎德内克岛围困占据罗得岛州纽波特的英军。他们决定解除围困，计划撤往阿奎德内克岛北部。随后，英军在新近抵达的皇家海军舰艇支援下出击，攻击正在撤退的美军。

en.s: The Battle of Newtown (August 29, 1779) was a major battle of the Sullivan Expedition, an armed offensive led by General John Sullivan that was ordered by the Continental Congress to end the threat of the Iroquois who had sided with the British in the American Revolutionary War. John Butler and Joseph Brant did not want to make a stand at Newtown, but proposed instead to harass the enemy on the march, but they were overruled by Sayenqueraghta and other Indian chiefs. The Battle of Chemung (August 13, 1779) was the only other major battle of the Sullivan Expedition where the Continental force lost six dead and nine wounded.

zh.s: 纽敦战役发生于1779年8月29日，是沙利文远征中的一场主要战斗。约翰·沙利文将军率领这次武装进攻，大陆会议下令行动，以消除在美国独立战争中支持英国的易洛魁人的威胁。约翰·巴特勒和约瑟夫·布兰特不想在纽敦正面迎战，而是建议在行军途中骚扰敌军，但赛恩克拉格塔和其他原住民首领否决了他们的提议。1779年8月13日的切蒙战役是沙利文远征中的另一场主要战斗，当时大陆军有6人阵亡、9人受伤。

en.s: The Raid on Annapolis Royal took place on 29 August 1781 during the American Revolutionary War. The raid involved two American privateers - the Resolution (commanded by William Morgan) and the Reprisal (commanded by John Curtis) - attacking and pillaging Annapolis Royal, Nova Scotia in revenge of the defeat of the Penobscot Expedition. The privateers took captive the commander of the militia John Ritchie, described as the "Governor of Annapolis."

zh.s: 美国独立战争期间，1781年8月29日，两艘美国私掠船“决心号”（由威廉·摩根指挥）和“报复号”（由约翰·柯蒂斯指挥）袭击并劫掠了新斯科舍省的安纳波利斯罗亚尔，以报复佩诺布斯科特远征失败。私掠船抓获了民兵指挥官约翰·里奇；他被称为“安纳波利斯总督”。

en.s: Shays's Rebellion was an armed uprising in Western Massachusetts and Worcester in response to a debt crisis among the citizenry and in opposition to the state government's increased efforts to collect taxes on both individuals and their trades. The fighting took place in the areas around Springfield during 1786 and 1787.

en.s: The Battle of Køge was fought on 29 August 1807 between British troops besieging Copenhagen and Danish militia raised on Sjælland as part of the Gunboat War. It ended in a British victory and is also known as 'Træskoslaget' or 'the Clogs Battle', since many of the Danish militiamen threw their heavy wooden clogs away when they were fleeing.

zh.s: 炮艇战争期间，1807年8月29日，围攻哥本哈根的英军与在西兰岛征召的丹麦民兵交战。英军获胜。这场战斗也称“木屐之战”，丹麦语为Træskoslaget，因为许多丹麦民兵逃跑时扔掉了沉重的木屐。

en.s: The Treaty of Rio de Janeiro is the treaty between the Kingdom of Portugal and the Empire of Brazil, signed August 29, 1825, which recognized Brazil as an independent nation, formally ending the Brazilian War of Independence. The treaty was ratified by the Emperor of Brazil on August 24, 1825, and by the King of Portugal on November 15, 1825, and on that same date the two instruments of ratification were exchanged between Brazilian and Portuguese diplomats in Lisbon.

zh.s: 葡萄牙王国与巴西帝国于1825年8月29日签署里约热内卢条约，承认巴西为独立国家，正式结束巴西独立战争。巴西皇帝于1825年8月24日批准条约，葡萄牙国王则于11月15日批准；同一天，巴西和葡萄牙外交官在里斯本交换了两国的批准文书。

en.s: The Bombardment of Tripoli in 1828 was a naval engagement fought between the navies of Tripoli and the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies. After the Pasha of Tripoli demanded money from the Kingdom of Two Sicilies in exchange for peace, the Neapolitan government sent a squadron to Tripoli to refuse the Tripolitanian demands and attempt to coerce the Tripolitanians away from war.

en.s: General elections were held in Belgium on 29 August 1831. They were the first elections to the new bicameral parliament created by the constitution adopted in February 1831. In the Senate elections Catholics won 31 seats and Liberals four. Voter turnout was 62.2%, although only 46,000 people (1.1% of the country's population) were eligible to vote.

zh.s: 比利时于1831年8月29日举行大选，这是1831年2月宪法通过后，新设两院制议会的首次选举。参议院选举中，天主教徒赢得31席，自由派赢得4席。投票率为62.2%，但只有46,000人（占全国人口的1.1%）有资格投票。

en.s: The Battle of Międzyrzec Podlaski, also known as the Battle of Rogoźnica, took place during the November Uprising, on 29 August 1831, in the area of the villages of Manie, Rogoźnica, and Międzyrzec Podlaski, in Congress Poland. It was fought by the insurgent forces of the Polish National Government, led by Girolamo Ramorino, against the forces of the Russian Empire, led by Georg Andreas von Rosen.

zh.t: 明济热茨-波德拉斯基战役
zh.s: 十一月起义期间，1831年8月29日，波兰会议王国的马涅、罗戈日尼察和明济热茨-波德拉斯基等村庄附近爆发战斗。吉罗拉莫·拉莫里诺率领的波兰国民政府起义军与格奥尔格·安德烈亚斯·冯·罗森率领的俄罗斯帝国军队交战。这场战役也称罗戈日尼察战役。

en.s: The Treaty of Nanjing was the peace treaty which ended the First Opium War (1839–1842) between Great Britain and the Qing dynasty of China on 29 August 1842. It was the second of what the Chinese later termed the unequal treaties, after the rejected 1841 Convention of Chuenpi, signed by British Superintendent of trade in China, Charles Elliot, and Qing Imperial Commissioner, Qishan, which the treaty was largely based on.

zh.s: 1842年8月29日，英国与清朝签订《南京条约》，结束了第一次鸦片战争（1839—1842年）。这是后来被中国称为“不平等条约”的第二个条约，前一个是1841年遭拒绝的《穿鼻草约》。《穿鼻草约》由英国驻华商务总监查理·义律和清朝钦差大臣琦善签署，《南京条约》很大程度上以此为基础。

en.s: The Battle of Boomplaats (also referred to as the Battle of Boomplaas) was fought near Jagersfontein at 29°50′53.47″S 25°38′56.54″E on 29 August 1848 between the British and the Voortrekkers. The British were led by Sir Harry Smith, while the Boers were led by Andries Pretorius. The British were victorious after one Boer opened fire too early and betrayed their position.

zh.s: 1848年8月29日，英国军队与布尔人的先民开拓者（Voortrekkers）在雅格斯方丹附近交战，地点坐标为南纬29°50′53.47″、东经25°38′56.54″。英军由哈里·史密斯爵士率领，布尔人由安德里斯·普雷托里乌斯率领。由于一名布尔人过早开火，暴露了己方位置，英军最终获胜。这场战斗也称布姆普拉斯战役。

en.s: The Battle of Hatteras Inlet Batteries (August 28–29, 1861) was the first combined operation of the Union Army and Navy in the American Civil War, resulting in Union domination of the strategically important North Carolina Sounds. Two forts on the Outer Banks, Fort Clark and Fort Hatteras, had been built by the Confederates to protect their commerce-raiding activity.
en.n: American Civil War: The Battle of Hatteras Inlet Batteries gives Federal forces control of Pamlico Sound.

zh.t: 哈特拉斯水道炮台战役
zh.s: 哈特拉斯水道炮台战役于1861年8月28日至29日进行，是美国内战期间联邦陆军和海军首次联合作战，结果联邦军控制了具有重要战略意义的北卡罗来纳湾区。邦联军曾在外滩修建克拉克堡和哈特拉斯堡，以保护其袭击商船的行动。
zh.n: 美国内战：哈特拉斯水道炮台战役使联邦军控制潘姆利科湾。

en.s: The Battle of Aspromonte, also known as the Day of Aspromonte (Italian: Giornata dell'Aspromonte), was a minor engagement that took place on 29 August 1862, and was an inconclusive episode of the Italian unification process. It is named after the nearby mountain of Aspromonte in southern Italy. Giuseppe Garibaldi's army of volunteers was attacked by the Royal Italian Army while marching from Sicily towards Rome, capital of the Papal States, which it intended to annex into the newly created Kingdom of Italy.

zh.s: 阿斯普罗蒙特战役也称阿斯普罗蒙特之日（意大利语：Giornata dell'Aspromonte），于1862年8月29日爆发，是意大利统一进程中一场没有明确结果的小规模交战。战役名称来自意大利南部附近的阿斯普罗蒙特山。朱塞佩·加里波第的志愿军从西西里岛向教皇国首都罗马进军，打算将罗马并入新成立的意大利王国，途中遭到意大利王家军队袭击。

en.s: The Battle of Smithfield Crossing was a small battle during the American Civil War fought August 25 through August 29, 1864, in Jefferson and Berkeley counties in West Virginia. On August 29, two Confederate infantry divisions under Lieutenant General Jubal Early crossed Opequon Creek at Smithfield Crossing and forced back Wesley Merritt's Union cavalry division. However, a counterattack from Ricketts' infantry division stopped the Confederate advance.

zh.t: 史密斯菲尔德渡口战役
zh.s: 美国内战期间，1864年8月25日至29日，史密斯菲尔德渡口战役在西弗吉尼亚州杰斐逊县和伯克利县爆发。8月29日，朱巴尔·厄尔中将率领两支邦联步兵师在史密斯菲尔德渡口渡过奥佩昆溪，击退了韦斯利·梅里特的联邦骑兵师。但里基茨步兵师随后反击，阻止了邦联军继续推进。

en.s: The Capture of Monterrey took place on 29 August 1864. It was fought between elements of the Mexican republican army and troops of the Second Mexican Empire during the French intervention in Mexico.

en.s: The Battle of the Tongue River, sometimes referred to as the Connor Battle, was an engagement of the Powder River Expedition that occurred on August 29, 1865. In the battle, U.S. soldiers and Indian scouts attacked and destroyed an Arapaho village.

zh.s: 这场战斗有时也称康纳战役，是粉河远征中的一次交战，发生于1865年8月29日。美国士兵和原住民侦察兵袭击并摧毁了一个阿拉帕霍村庄。

en.s: The Battle of Nouart was fought on 29 August 1870 at the village of Nouart. Part of the Franco-Prussian War of 1870–1871, the battle saw Prince George's 46th Infantry Brigade of the XII Royal Saxony Corps defeat Pierre Louis Charles de Failly's V Corps of the French Empire.

zh.s: 1870年8月29日，努阿尔村发生战斗，是1870至1871年普法战争的一部分。乔治亲王率领的萨克森王国第十二军团第46步兵旅击败了皮埃尔·路易·夏尔·德·法伊的法兰西帝国第五军团。

en.s: The Battle of Manila (Filipino: Labanan sa Maynila; Spanish: Batalla de Manila) occurred in Manila in the Spanish colony of the Philippines during the Philippine Revolution. Katipunan under Andres Bonifacio attempted to take the city but the attempt failed, and Bonifacio retreated to the city's outskirts. The Battle of San Juan del Monte was joined a day later when Bonifacio attempted to capture the San Juan's powder magazine, but this too failed.

zh.s: 菲律宾革命期间，马尼拉战役在西班牙殖民统治下的马尼拉爆发。卡蒂普南组织在安德烈斯·博尼法西奥率领下试图夺取该城，但未能成功，博尼法西奥撤至城郊。一天后，博尼法西奥又试图夺取圣胡安的火药库，由此爆发圣胡安德尔蒙特战役，但这次行动也失败了。

en.t: The Goodyear tire company is founded in Akron, Ohio
en.s: The Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company, commonly known as Goodyear, is an American multinational tire manufacturer headquartered in Akron, Ohio. Since 2021, the company has been the world's third-largest tire manufacturer by annual revenue. Goodyear manufactures tires for passenger vehicles, aviation, commercial trucks, military and police vehicles, motorcycles, recreational vehicles, race cars, and heavy off-road machinery.

zh.t: 固特异轮胎公司在俄亥俄州阿克伦成立
zh.s: 固特异轮胎橡胶公司，通常简称固特异，是一家总部位于俄亥俄州阿克伦的美国跨国轮胎制造商。自2021年以来，按年收入计算，该公司一直是全球第三大轮胎制造商。固特异为乘用车、航空器、商用卡车、军警车辆、摩托车、休闲车辆、赛车和重型越野机械生产轮胎。

en.s: The Japan–Korea Treaty of 1910, also known as the Japan–Korea Annexation Treaty (Korean: 한일병합조약), was made by representatives of the Empire of Japan and the Korean Empire on 22 August 1910. In this treaty, Japan formally annexed Korea following the Japan–Korea Treaty of 1905 (by which Korea became a protectorate of Japan) and the Japan–Korea Treaty of 1907 (by which Korea was deprived of the administration of internal affairs).

en.s: The Jones Law (39 Stat. 545, also known as the Jones Act, the Philippine Autonomy Act, and formally the Act of Congress of August 29, 1916) was an organic act passed by the United States Congress. The law replaced the Philippine Organic Act of 1902 and acted as a constitution of the Philippines from its enactment until 1934, when the Tydings–McDuffie Act was passed (which in turn led eventually to the Commonwealth of the Philippines and to independence from the United States).

zh.s: 《琼斯法案》（《美国法典》第39卷第545页），又称《琼斯法》或《菲律宾自治法》，正式名称为《1916年8月29日国会法案》，是美国国会通过的一项组织法。该法案取代了1902年《菲律宾组织法》，并自颁布起充当菲律宾宪法，直到1934年《泰丁斯—麦克杜菲法案》通过；后者最终促成菲律宾联邦的成立以及菲律宾脱离美国独立。

en.s: Operation Safari (German: Unternehmen Safari) was a German military operation during World War II aimed at disarming the Danish military. It led to the scuttling of the Royal Danish Navy and the internment of all Danish soldiers. Danish forces suffered 23–26 dead, around 40–50 injured, and 4,600 captured. Of the roughly 9,000 Germans involved, one was killed and eight wounded, although the number may have been 11 killed and 59 wounded.

zh.s: 野生动物园行动（德语：Unternehmen Safari）是第二次世界大战期间德国为解除丹麦军队武装而开展的军事行动。行动导致丹麦皇家海军自沉，所有丹麦士兵被拘押。丹麦方面有23至26人死亡、约40至50人受伤，4,600人被俘。约9,000名德军中有1人死亡、8人受伤，不过也有说法称德军伤亡为11人死亡、59人受伤。

en.t: World War II: German-occupied Denmark scuttles most of its navy; Germany dissolves the Danish government
en.s: At the outset of World War II in September 1939, Denmark declared itself neutral, but that neutrality did not prevent Nazi Germany from occupying the country soon after the outbreak of war; the occupation lasted until Germany's defeat. The decision to occupy Denmark was taken in Berlin on 17 December 1939. On 9 April 1940, Germany invaded Denmark in Operation Weserübung.

zh.t: 第二次世界大战：德国占领下的丹麦凿沉大部分海军舰艇；德国解散丹麦政府
zh.s: 1939年9月第二次世界大战爆发时，丹麦宣布中立，但这并未阻止纳粹德国在战争爆发后不久占领该国；占领一直持续到德国战败。德国于1939年12月17日在柏林作出占领丹麦的决定。1940年4月9日，德国发动“威悉演习”入侵丹麦。

en.s: The Slovak National Uprising (Slovak: Slovenské národné povstanie, abbreviated SNP; alternatively also Povstanie roku 1944, English: The Uprising of 1944) was an attempted insurrection organised by the Slovak resistance during the Second World War. It was directed on the one hand against the German invasion of Slovakia by the Wehrmacht, which began on 29 August 1944, and on the other against the Slovak collaborationist regime of the Ludaks under Jozef Tiso.

zh.s: 斯洛伐克民族起义（斯洛伐克语：Slovenské národné povstanie，简称SNP，也称Povstanie roku 1944，意为“1944年起义”）是第二次世界大战期间由斯洛伐克抵抗力量组织的一场起义，最终未能成功。起义一方面反对德意志国防军入侵斯洛伐克（入侵于1944年8月29日开始），另一方面反对约瑟夫·蒂索领导的斯洛伐克亲纳粹政权。

en.s: Operation Goodwood was a series of British carrier air raids conducted against the German battleship Tirpitz at her anchorage in Kaafjord in occupied Norway during late August 1944. It was the last of several attacks made by the Home Fleet during 1944 which sought to damage or sink Tirpitz and thereby eliminate the threat it posed to Allied shipping.

zh.s: 1944年8月下旬，英国航母舰载机对停泊在被占领挪威卡峡湾的德国战列舰“提尔皮茨”号发动一系列空袭，这些行动统称为古德伍德行动。这是英国本土舰队1944年多次攻击“提尔皮茨”号行动中的最后一次，目的是将其击伤或击沉，从而消除它对盟军航运的威胁。

en.s: The Lvov–Sandomierz offensive or Lvov–Sandomierz strategic offensive operation (Russian: Львовско-Сандомирская стратегическая наступательная операция) was a major Second World War operation by the Soviet Red Army to force German troops from Ukraine and Eastern Poland. The operation was launched in mid-July 1944, and successfully completed by the end of August. The Lvov–Sandomierz offensive is generally overshadowed by the overwhelming successes of the concurrently conducted Operation Bagration that led to the destruction of the German Army Group Centre.

zh.s: 利沃夫—桑多梅日攻势，也称利沃夫—桑多梅日战略进攻行动（俄语：Львовско-Сандомирская стратегическая наступательная операция），是第二次世界大战期间苏联红军发动的一场大型行动，目标是将德军赶出乌克兰和波兰东部。行动于1944年7月中旬发起，到8月底顺利结束。它通常被同期进行的“巴格拉季昂行动”所掩盖；该行动取得压倒性胜利，并摧毁了德军中央集团军群。

en.s: The Šiauliai offensive (Russian: Шяуляйская операция) was an operation of the Soviet forces of the 1st Baltic Front, commanded by General Hovhannes Bagramyan, conducted from 5 July to 29 August 1944, during the Second World War. It was part of the third phase of the Belorussian strategic offensive operation (also known as Operation Bagration), and drove German troops from much of Lithuania, with the main tactical objective of the city of Šiauliai (Russian: Шяуля́й, German: Schaulen).

en.s: The Jassy–Kishinev offensive, named after the two major cities, Jassy and Kishinev, in the staging area, was a Soviet offensive against Axis forces, which took place in Eastern Romania from 20 to 29 August 1944 during World War II. The 2nd and 3rd Ukrainian Fronts of the Red Army engaged Army Group South Ukraine, which consisted of combined German and Romanian formations, in an operation to reoccupy Bessarabia and destroy the Axis forces in the region, opening the way into Romania and the Balkans.

en.s: Northwest Orient Airlines Flight 421 was a domestic scheduled passenger flight from Chicago, Illinois, to Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States, that crashed on 29 August 1948. The Martin 2-0-2 aircraft, operated by Northwest Orient Airlines, suffered structural failure in its left wing and crashed approximately 4.1 miles (6.6 km) northwest of Winona, Minnesota, about 95 miles (153 km) southeast of Minneapolis.

zh.s: 西北东方航空421号班机是一趟美国国内定期客运航班，从伊利诺伊州芝加哥飞往明尼苏达州明尼阿波利斯。1948年8月29日，西北东方航空运营的马丁2-0-2型飞机左翼发生结构故障，在明尼苏达州威诺纳西北约4.1英里（6.6公里）处坠毁；坠机地点位于明尼阿波利斯东南约95英里（153公里）。

en.s: Maverick Concert Hall was built in 1916 and was part of the Maverick Artist Colony in Hurley, New York. The Maverick developed out of the Maverick Festival, an early 20th-century communal arts gathering near Woodstock that combined music, theater, and outdoor performance in a rustic woodland setting. Contemporary newspaper accounts described the Maverick Festival as a rustic outdoor arts community near Woodstock where music, theater, and dance were staged in converted woodland performance spaces.
en.n: American experimental composer John Cage's 4’33” premieres at Maverick Concert Hall, played by American pianist David Tudor.

zh.s: 马弗里克音乐厅建于1916年，是纽约州赫利镇马弗里克艺术家聚居地的一部分。马弗里克艺术活动源于20世纪初的马弗里克艺术节。这一在伍德斯托克附近举行的早期社区艺术活动，把音乐、戏剧和户外演出结合起来，在质朴的林地环境中举办。根据当时报纸的记载，马弗里克艺术节是伍德斯托克附近一个质朴的户外艺术社区，人们在改建成演出场地的林间空间里表演音乐、戏剧和舞蹈。
zh.n: 美国实验作曲家约翰·凯奇的《4分33秒》在马弗里克音乐厅首演，由美国钢琴家大卫·都铎演奏。

en.s: 4′33″ is a modernist composition by American experimental composer John Cage. It was composed in 1952 for any instrument or combination of instruments; the score instructs performers not to play their instruments throughout the three movements. It is divided into three movements, lasting 30 seconds, 2 minutes and 23 seconds, and 1 minute and 40 seconds, respectively, although Cage later stated that the movements' durations can be determined by the musician.

zh.s: 《4分33秒》是美国实验作曲家约翰·凯奇创作的一部现代主义作品。它创作于1952年，可由任何乐器演奏，也可由多种乐器合奏；乐谱要求演奏者在三个乐章中都不要演奏乐器。三个乐章分别时长30秒、2分23秒和1分40秒，不过凯奇后来表示，各乐章的时长可以由演奏者自行决定。

en.s: Air France Flight 343 was a scheduled international passenger flight from Paris, France, to Abidjan, Ivory Coast, with scheduled stopovers at Dakar, Senegal, and Monrovia, Liberia. en.t: Leading Egyptian thinker Sayyid Qutb is executed for plotting the assassination of President Gamal Abdel Nasser
en.s: Sayyid Ibrahim Husayn Shadhili Qutb (9 October 1906 – 29 August 1966) was an Egyptian political theorist and revolutionary who was a leading member of the Muslim Brotherhood. As the author of 24 published books, with around 30 unpublished for different reasons (mainly due to destruction by the state), and at least 581 articles, including novels, literary arts critique and works on education, Qutb is best known in the Muslim world for his work on what he believed to be the social and political role of Islam, particularly in his books Social Justice and Ma'alim fi al-Tariq (Milestones).

zh.t: 埃及著名思想家赛义德·库特布因策划刺杀总统贾迈勒·阿卜杜勒·纳赛尔而被处决
zh.s: 赛义德·易卜拉欣·侯赛因·沙兹利·库特布（1906年10月9日—1966年8月29日）是埃及政治理论家和革命者，也是穆斯林兄弟会的重要成员。他出版了24本书，另有约30本因各种原因（主要是被政府销毁）未能出版的作品，并发表至少581篇文章，内容包括小说、文学艺术评论和教育论著。库特布在穆斯林世界最为人熟知的是他对伊斯兰社会和政治角色的论述，尤其是《社会正义》和《路标》两书。

en.s: The Ghanaian parliamentary election was held on 29 August 1969. This was the first parliamentary election since the 1966 coup by the National Liberation Council which toppled the Nkrumah government, and the first relatively free election in the country's history. The election was to select members for the 140 seat legislative body. Kofi Abrefa Busia, the leader of the Progress Party (which won 105 of the 140 seats) became the Prime Minister of Ghana. There were no presidential elections. Instead, a figurehead president, Edward Akufo-Addo, was elected by an electoral college.

zh.s: 加纳于1969年8月29日举行议会选举。这是1966年民族解放委员会发动政变、推翻恩克鲁玛政府以来的首次议会选举，也是该国历史上首次相对自由的选举。选举产生140席立法机构的成员。进步党赢得105席，该党领袖科菲·阿布雷法·布西亚随后成为加纳总理。本次没有直接举行总统选举，而是由选举团选出礼仪性总统爱德华·阿库福-阿多。

en.s: The Tacnazo was a military coup launched by then Peruvian Prime Minister, General Francisco Morales Bermúdez against the administration of President Gen. Juan Velasco Alvarado in 1975. This led to what is known in Peru as the "Second Phase" of the Revolutionary Government of the Armed Forces, which lasted until the elections of 1980.

en.s: The Sam Muchnick Memorial Tournament was a World Wrestling Federation (WWF) supercard held at the sold-out Kiel Auditorium in St. Louis, Missouri on August 29, 1986, attended by nearly 11,000 fans and making $87,000. The event was held as a tribute to longtime St. Louis promoter Sam Muchnick and featured a 16-man single-elimination tournament which saw Harley Race defeat Ricky Steamboat in the tournament finals. The semi-main event included a match between Hulk Hogan and Paul Orndorff for the WWF World Heavyweight Championship .

en.s: The Evangelical Baptist Church (EBC) of Korea (Korean: 기독교복음침례회; officially Korean Evangelical Baptist Church – formerly known as Korean Laymen's Evangelical Fellowship) was established in 1962 by Yoo Byung-eun and Pastor Kwon Shin-chan (권신찬; 1923–96). In South Korea, EBC is commonly known as Guwonpa, meaning Salvation Sect, from the Korean term guwon (구원), "salvation".

en.s: SummerSlam 1988 was the first annual SummerSlam professional wrestling pay-per-view event. It was produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF) and took place on August 29, 1988, in Madison Square Garden, located in New York City, New York. The pay-per-view was created to help the company compete against rival promotion World Championship Wrestling (formerly Jim Crockett Promotions). It was one of the first four annual pay-per-view events produced by the WWF, along with WrestleMania, the Royal Rumble, and Survivor Series. The event consisted of ten professional wrestling matches.

en.s: A special election to determine the member of the United States House of Representatives for Florida's 18th congressional district was held on August 29, 1989. Republican Ileana Ros-Lehtinen defeated Democrat Gerald Richman in the runoff vote, 53.14% to 46.85%. Ros-Lehtinen replaced Claude Pepper, who died in office from stomach cancer. Changing demographics in Florida's 18th congressional district had seen the largely white district change into a 40% Cuban American district.

en.s: SummerSlam (1992) was the fifth annual SummerSlam professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF). It took place on August 29, 1992, at Wembley Stadium, London, England but was aired in the United States on August 31. The buildup to the pay-per-view consisted of feuds scripted by the WWF's writers. To date it is the only major WWF pay-per-view to take place outside North America. The pay-per-view featured two main-event matches. In the first, The Ultimate Warrior challenged Randy Savage for the WWF World Heavyweight Championship. The Warrior won the match by countout but did not win the title.

zh.s: 世界摔角联盟（WWF）制作的第五届年度付费赛事“夏日狂潮”于1992年8月29日在英格兰伦敦的温布利体育场举行，但在美国于8月31日播出。赛前剧情由WWF编剧安排的恩怨故事组成。就原文所述，该赛事是WWF唯一一场在北美以外举行的大型付费赛事。比赛设有两场主赛，第一场由终极战士挑战兰迪·萨维奇的WWF世界重量级冠军头衔。终极战士因对手数秒未能回到擂台而获胜，但没有赢得冠军。

en.s: The 1992 Greek Super Cup was the 5th edition of the Greek Super Cup, an association football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Alpha Ethniki and Greek Cup competitions. The match took place on 29 August 1992 at the Athens Olympic Stadium. The contesting teams were the 1991–92 Alpha Ethniki champions, AEK Athens and the 1991–92 Greek Cup winners, Olympiacos.

en.s: SummerSlam (1994) was the seventh annual SummerSlam, a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF) on August 29, 1994, at the newly opened United Center in Chicago, Illinois, which had opened eleven days earlier. The pay-per-view had two main events. The first pitted Owen Hart against his brother Bret Hart in a steel cage match. Bret won the match, but the storyline feud escalated after Owen and his brother-in-law Jim Neidhart attacked Bret after the match. The other main event was a match between the real Undertaker (portrayed by Mark Calaway) and an impostor Undertaker (portrayed by Brian Lee).

zh.s: 世界摔角联盟（WWF）制作的第七届年度付费赛事“夏日狂潮”于1994年8月29日在芝加哥新近启用的联合中心举行，该场馆当时才开放11天。赛事设有两场主赛：第一场是欧文·哈特与哥哥布雷特·哈特的铁笼赛。布雷特获胜，但赛后欧文和妹夫吉姆·奈德哈特袭击布雷特，使剧情中的兄弟恩怨进一步升级。另一场主赛由“真正的送葬者”（马克·卡拉韦饰）对阵冒牌送葬者（布赖恩·李饰）。

en.s: The 1995 Gua Musang by-election was a by-election that was held on 29 August 1995 for the Dewan Rakyat seat of Gua Musang. It was called following the void result of 1995 Malaysian general election for the seat by the High Court on 1 August 1995. The petition was filed by Barisan Nasional candidate, Hussein Ahmad whose candidacy for the election was rejected by the returning officer on the nomination day.

zh.s: 马来西亚人民代表院瓜拉姆桑选区于1995年8月29日举行补选。此前，高等法院于1995年8月1日宣布该选区的1995年马来西亚大选结果无效。国民阵线候选人侯赛因·艾哈迈德提出了选举请愿；他在提名日被选举官拒绝登记为候选人。

en.s: Vnukovo Airlines Flight 2801 was an international charter flight that, on 29 August 1996 at 10:22:23 Central European Summer Time, crashed in Operafjellet, Svalbard, Norway. All 141 people aboard the Tupolev Tu-154M were killed during the approach to Svalbard Airport, Longyear, making it the deadliest aviation accident ever in Norway.

zh.t: 伏努科沃航空2801号班机空难
zh.s: 伏努科沃航空2801号班机是一趟国际包机，于1996年8月29日中欧夏令时10时22分23秒在挪威斯瓦尔巴群岛的奥佩拉菲耶莱特坠毁。图-154M飞机上的141人全部遇难。事故发生在飞机接近斯瓦尔巴朗伊尔机场时，是挪威历史上死亡人数最多的航空事故。

en.s: Cubana de Aviación Flight 389 (CU389/CUB389) was a scheduled international passenger flight, flying from the former Mariscal Sucre International Airport in Quito to Havana's José Martí International Airport, with a stopover at Simón Bolívar International Airport in Guayaquil, operated by Cuban flag carrier Cubana de Aviación. On 29 August 1998, the aircraft operating the domestic Quito-Guayaquil leg of the flight, a Russian-made Tupolev Tu-154M overran the runway, smashing buildings and crashed into a soccer field in Quito while taking off from the airport.

zh.s: 古巴航空389号班机（CU389/CUB389）是一趟定期国际客运航班，由古巴国家航空公司古巴航空运营，从基多原马里斯卡尔·苏克雷国际机场飞往哈瓦那何塞·马蒂国际机场，中途在瓜亚基尔的西蒙·玻利瓦尔国际机场经停。1998年8月29日，执行基多至瓜亚基尔国内航段的俄制图-154M飞机起飞时冲出跑道，撞毁建筑后坠入基多一处足球场。

en.s: The 1998 Tasmanian state election was held on Saturday, 29 August 1998 in the Australian state of Tasmania to elect 25 members of the Tasmanian House of Assembly. The number of members was reduced from 35 to 25. The election used the Hare-Clark proportional representation system—five members were elected from each of five electorates. The quota required for election increased from 12.5% to 16.7%.

zh.s: 澳大利亚塔斯马尼亚州于1998年8月29日星期六举行州选举，选出25名州众议院议员。议员人数从35人减至25人。选举采用黑尔-克拉克比例代表制，五个选区各选出5名议员。候选人当选所需的选票配额从12.5%提高到16.7%。

en.s: The 1998 Supercoppa Italiana was a match contested by Juventus, the 1997–98 Serie A winner, and Lazio, the 1997–98 Coppa Italia winner. It was the fourth appearance for Juventus (victories in 1995 and 1997), whereas it was Lazio's first appearance, and first victory.

zh.s: 1998年意大利超级杯由1997—98赛季意甲冠军尤文图斯对阵意大利杯冠军拉齐奥。尤文图斯此前三次参赛，并在1995年和1997年夺冠；拉齐奥则是首次参赛，并首次赢得超级杯。

en.s: 1999 Uzbekistan Super Cup (Футбол бўйича 1999–йилги Ўзбекистон Суперкубоги) was the first match in the history of the Uzbekistan Super Cup. According to some sources, the tournament was also referred to as the "Uzbekistan President's Cup" in 1999. It took place on 29 August at the "Fergana" stadium in the city of Fergana (capacity: 16,000 spectators). 6,000 fans attended the match.

zh.s: 1999年乌兹别克斯坦超级杯（乌兹别克语：Футбол бўйича 1999–йилги Ўзбекистон Суперкубоги）是乌兹别克斯坦超级杯历史上的首场比赛。据一些资料记载，该赛事在1999年也称“乌兹别克斯坦总统杯”。比赛于8月29日在费尔干纳市的“费尔干纳”体育场举行，球场可容纳16,000名观众，现场有6,000名球迷观赛。

en.s: Binter Mediterráneo Flight 8261 on 29 August 2001, is a crash that landed next to the N-340 highway, some 200 meters short of runway 32 at Ruiz Picasso International Airport at Málaga, Spain. The captain reported a fire in the aircraft's port engine to Málaga Air Traffic Control while on final approach.

zh.s: 2001年8月29日，Binter Mediterráneo 8261号班机坠毁在西班牙马拉加鲁伊斯·毕加索国际机场32号跑道前约200米、N-340公路旁。飞机正准备降落时，机长向马拉加空中交通管制报告左侧发动机起火。

en.s: The Imam Ali mosque bombing was the detonation of two car bombs outside the Shia Imam Ali Mosque in Najaf on 29 August 2003. The attack killed 95 people crowded around the mosque for Friday prayers, including Ayatollah Mohammed Baqir al-Hakim, spiritual leader of the Supreme Council of the Islamic Revolution in Iraq. The attack was devastating for the Shia community in Iraq, because such a revered cleric was killed and many people died. The bombing was the deadliest attack in Iraq in 2003. In response to the attack, thousands of Shia mourners marched in the streets of cities and towns across Iraq.

zh.t: 伊玛目阿里清真寺爆炸案
zh.s: 2003年8月29日，两辆汽车炸弹在伊拉克纳杰夫的什叶派伊玛目阿里清真寺外引爆。当时许多人聚集在清真寺参加周五祷告，袭击造成95人死亡，其中包括伊拉克伊斯兰革命最高委员会的精神领袖穆罕默德·巴基尔·哈基姆大阿亚图拉。这场爆炸导致一位受尊崇的宗教领袖和许多民众遇难，令伊拉克什叶派社区深受打击。这是2003年伊拉克伤亡最惨重的袭击。事后，数千名什叶派哀悼者走上伊拉克各地城市和城镇的街头游行。

en.s: The 2003 UEFA Super Cup was played on 29 August 2003 between Milan of Italy and Porto of Portugal. Milan qualified by defeating Juventus in the 2003 UEFA Champions League Final, while Porto qualified by beating Celtic in the 2003 UEFA Cup Final. Milan won the match 1–0. After the match, defeated Porto manager José Mourinho said, "We leave here convinced we can go into the UEFA Champions League with the hope and certainty we can compete with any team."

zh.s: 2003年欧洲超级杯于2003年8月29日举行，由意大利AC米兰对阵葡萄牙波尔图。米兰在2003年欧洲冠军联赛决赛中击败尤文图斯后取得参赛资格，波尔图则在欧洲联盟杯决赛中击败凯尔特人后晋级。米兰以1比0获胜。落败的波尔图主教练若泽·穆里尼奥赛后说：“我们离开这里时确信，带着希望和信心，我们能够在欧洲冠军联赛中与任何球队较量。”

en.t: Effects of Hurricane Katrina in New Orleans
en.s: As the center of Hurricane Katrina passed southeast of New Orleans on August 29, 2005, winds downtown were in the Category 1 range with frequent intense gusts. The storm surge caused approximately 23 breaches in the drainage canal and navigational canal levees and flood walls. As mandated in the Flood Control Act of 1965, responsibility for the design and construction of the city’s levees belongs to the United States Army Corps of Engineers and responsibility for their maintenance belongs to the Orleans Levee District.

zh.t: 卡特里娜飓风对新奥尔良的影响
zh.s: 2005年8月29日，卡特里娜飓风中心从新奥尔良东南方经过时，市中心风力达到1级飓风强度，并频繁出现强阵风。风暴潮导致排水渠和航道沿线的堤坝及防洪墙约23处决口。根据1965年《洪水控制法》，该市堤坝的设计和建造由美国陆军工程兵团负责，维护则由奥尔良堤坝区负责。

en.s: The Battle of Karbala began on the night of 27 August 2007 and involved fighting between the Mahdi Army, who provided security for the pilgrims, and police (who were largely members of the Badr Organization) in Karbala, Iraq. Hundreds of thousands of Shia pilgrims gathered in the city for the annual festival of Mid-Sha'ban. Security was high as pilgrims had been killed in previous years by suicide bombers.

en.s: Sin Piedad (2008) (Spanish for "No Mercy") was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) produced by Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL), which took place on August 29, 2008 in Arena Mexico, Mexico City, Mexico. The 2008 Sin Piedad was the seventh event under that name that CMLL promoted as their last major show of the year, always held in December. The main event was Six-man "Lucha Libre rules" tag team match between Blue Panther, Dos Caras Jr. and Dr. Wagner Jr. and the team of Black Warrior, Mr. Niebla and Rey Bucanero.

zh.s: Sin Piedad（2008年，西班牙语意为“毫不留情”）是世界摔角理事会（CMLL）制作的职业摔角付费观看（PPV）赛事，于2008年8月29日在墨西哥墨西哥城的墨西哥竞技场举行。这是CMLL以Sin Piedad为名举办的第七场赛事，也是当年最后一场大型赛事；该系列通常在12月举行。主赛是一场六人制“Lucha Libre规则”组队赛，对阵双方分别是Blue Panther、Dos Caras Jr.和Dr. Wagner Jr.，以及Black Warrior、Mr. Niebla和Rey Bucanero。

en.s: The 2010 Tsentoroy Attack was an insurgent operation carried out on the morning of 29 August 2010 by Chechen rebels in Tsentoroy (also known as Khosi-Yurt), Chechnya, the home village and stronghold of pro-Moscow Chechen President Ramzan Kadyrov. The assault - which represented the largest and most audacious attack launched in the republic for over a year - is considered to have "shattered" the image of Kadyrov's unshakeable rule in Chechnya, as it was the first time in six years that his seemingly impregnable village had come under attack.

zh.s: 2010年8月29日上午，车臣叛乱武装袭击了车臣的岑托罗伊村（又称霍西-尤尔特）。该村是亲莫斯科的车臣总统拉姆赞·卡德罗夫的家乡和势力据点。这是车臣共和国一年多来规模最大、最大胆的一次袭击，被认为打破了卡德罗夫在当地统治牢不可破的形象；此前六年来，他看似固若金汤的村庄首次遭到攻击。

en.s: An indirect presidential election took place in Estonia on August 29, 2011. There were two candidates: incumbent president Toomas Hendrik Ilves and European parliament deputy Indrek Tarand. For the first time in the country's post-Soviet history, only one round took place, as Ilves was able to secure the necessary two-thirds majority to get re-elected without a runoff. Ilves received 73 votes while Tarand obtained only 25. One vote was blank and two were disqualified. Ilves was supported by the ruling Estonian Reform Party and Union of Pro Patria and Res Publica, as well as the Social Democratic Party, to which he formerly belonged.

zh.s: 爱沙尼亚于2011年8月29日举行间接总统选举，共有两名候选人：时任总统托马斯·亨德里克·伊尔韦斯和欧洲议会议员因德雷克·塔兰德。这是该国后苏联时期首次只进行一轮投票，伊尔韦斯取得连任所需的三分之二多数，无须举行决选。伊尔韦斯获得73票，塔兰德获得25票；另有1张空白票，2票作废。支持伊尔韦斯的包括执政的爱沙尼亚改革党、祖国联盟和共和党以及他曾经所属的社会民主党。

en.t: 2011 Democratic Party of Japan leadership election
en.s: The 2011 Democratic Party of Japan leadership election took place on 29 August 2011. The election was held to replace outgoing president and Prime Minister Naoto Kan, who resigned on 26 August. In a field of five candidates, finance minister Yoshihiko Noda pulled off a come-from-behind victory against economy minister Banri Kaieda. Noda secured support from members who had previously supported Seiji Maehara and Michihiko Kano, delivering him a majority in the runoff.

zh.s: 日本民主党于2011年8月29日举行党魁选举，接替8月26日辞职的卸任党首兼首相菅直人。五名候选人中，财务大臣野田佳彦后来居上，击败经济产业大臣海江田万里。野田获得此前支持前原诚司和鹿野道彦的党员支持，在决选中取得多数。

en.s: The Xiaojiawan coal mine disaster was a mining accident which happened on 29 August 2012 at the Xiaojiawan coal mine (Chinese: 肖家湾煤矿), located in Panzhihua in Sichuan Province, China. It was the deadliest mine accident since the 2009 Heilongjiang mine explosion. As a result of a gas explosion in the Xiaojiawan coal mine, at least 45 miners were killed and 1 was still missing as of September 2. 51 were sent to hospital with seven in critical condition. It was reported that 16 miners died from carbon monoxide poisoning, while three others died in hospital.

zh.s: 2012年8月29日，中国四川省攀枝花市肖家湾煤矿发生矿难，是2009年黑龙江矿难以来最严重的一次。煤矿瓦斯爆炸造成至少45名矿工死亡；截至9月2日，仍有1人失踪。另有51人被送往医院，其中7人伤势危重。据报道，16名矿工死于一氧化碳中毒，另有3人在医院死亡。

In 2012, Fanja SC, the champion of the 2011-12 Oman Professional League, played Dhofar S.C.S.C., the champion of the 2011 Sultan Qaboos Cup. The match was played at the Royal Oman Police Stadium in Muscat, Oman, on 29 August 2012, with Fanja winning 1-0.

en.t: 2012 Peñón de Vélez de la Gomera incident
en.s: The 2012 Peñón de Vélez de la Gomera incident was a territorial incident that involved Spain and Morocco, the second fought in the 21st century after the one that occurred on Perejil Island in 2002.

en.t: The XIV Paralympic Games open in London, England, United Kingdom
en.s: The 2012 Summer Paralympics, branded as the London 2012 Paralympic Games, were an international multi-sport parasports event held from 29 August to 9 September 2012 in London, England, United Kingdom. They were the 14th Summer Paralympic Games as organised by the International Paralympic Committee (IPC). These Games were the first Summer Paralympics to be hosted by London and the first to be hosted solely by Great Britain.

zh.t: 第14届夏季残奥会在英国伦敦开幕
zh.s: 2012年夏季残奥会又称伦敦2012残奥会，是一场国际综合性残疾人体育赛事，于2012年8月29日至9月9日在英国伦敦举行。这是国际残奥委员会（IPC）举办的第14届夏季残奥会，也是伦敦首次主办夏季残奥会、英国首次独立主办该赛事。

en.s: The 2014 Oman Super Cup was the 12th edition of the Oman Super Cup, an annual football match between Al-Nahda Club the champions of the 2013–14 Oman Professional League and Fanja SC, the winners of the 2013–14 Sultan Qaboos Cup. en.s: The 41st Telluride Film Festival took place on August 29–September 1, 2014, in Telluride, Colorado, United States. Telluride honored director Volker Schlöndorff, actress Hilary Swank and feature Apocalypse Now as the awardees of the Silver Medallion. en.s: The Democratic Party held a leadership election on 29 August 2020. It was the second leadership election since the inauguration of President Moon Jae-in. Although an elected leader serves for the fixed two-year term, the newly elected leader Lee Nak-yon is unlikely to serve for two years due to his presumptive presidential campaign in 2022.

en.s: The 2020 FA Community Shield (also known as The FA Community Shield supported by McDonald's for sponsorship reasons) was the 98th FA Community Shield, an annual football match played between the winners of the previous season's Premier League, Liverpool, and the previous season's FA Cup, Arsenal, with the latter winning on penalties after a 1–1 draw. This was the fourth Charity Shield/Community Shield contested between the two clubs: Liverpool won in 1979 and 1989, while Arsenal were victorious in 2002. The match was televised live on BT Sport 1, BT Sport Extra 1 and BT Sport Ultimate, with highlights shown later on Match of the Day on BBC One. Radio commentary was provided by Sam Matterface and Trevor Sinclair on Talksport. The game was played behind closed doors on 29 August 2020 at Wembley Stadium and followed the Women's Community Shield match at the same venue, thus forming the first Community Shield double-header.

zh.s: 2020年英格兰社区盾杯是第98届社区盾杯，因赞助原因也称“麦当劳支持的英格兰社区盾杯”。这项年度赛事由上赛季英超冠军利物浦对阵足总杯冠军阿森纳，双方1比1战平后，阿森纳在点球大战中获胜。这是两队第四次在慈善盾杯／社区盾杯上交手：利物浦曾于1979年和1989年获胜，阿森纳则于2002年取胜。比赛于2020年8月29日在温布利球场举行，没有观众入场，并在同一场地的女子社区盾杯之后进行，首次组成社区盾杯双赛。BT Sport 1、BT Sport Extra 1和BT Sport Ultimate现场直播了比赛，BBC One的《当日比赛》节目随后播出集锦。Talksport的广播解说员是萨姆·马特费斯和特雷弗·辛克莱。

en.s: The 2020 Women's FA Community Shield was the ninth Women's FA Community Shield, and the first after the competition's revival following an eleven-season abeyance. en.t: Russo-Ukrainian war: Ukraine begins its southern counteroffensive in the Kherson Oblast, eventually culminating in the liberation of the city of Kherson
en.s: The Russo-Ukrainian war began in February 2014 and is ongoing. Following Ukraine's Revolution of Dignity, Russia occupied Crimea and annexed it from Ukraine. It then supported Russian separatist armed groups who started a war in the eastern Donbas region against Ukraine's military. In 2018, Ukraine declared the region to be occupied by Russia. The first eight years of conflict also involved naval incidents and cyberwarfare.

zh.t: 俄乌战争：乌克兰在赫尔松州发动南部反攻，最终解放赫尔松市
zh.s: 俄乌战争始于2014年2月，至今仍在持续。尊严革命后，俄罗斯占领克里米亚并将其并入俄罗斯。随后，俄罗斯支持当地亲俄分离武装在顿巴斯东部地区与乌克兰军队交战。2018年，乌克兰宣布该地区遭俄罗斯占领。冲突的最初八年还涉及海上事件和网络战。

en.s: Summer of the Beasts (2024) was a professional wrestling live streaming event produced by Major League Wrestling (MLW) that took place on August 29, 2024, at the Melrose Ballroom in Queens, New York. The event streamed live on MLW's YouTube channel. A "surprise" streaming special called "Summer of the Beasts: Part 2", featuring unseen dark matches from the event, and the Bobby Fish vs Timothy Thatcher match that was cut from the live broadcast due to technical issues, would be uploaded to YouTube on September 7.

zh.s: 职业摔角联盟（MLW）制作的现场直播赛事“2024年野兽之夏”于2024年8月29日在纽约皇后区的梅尔罗斯舞厅举行，并在MLW的YouTube频道直播。9月7日，YouTube上传了一场名为“野兽之夏：第二部”的特别节目，作为一项“惊喜”内容，收录了该赛事中未播出的暗赛，以及因技术问题而从直播中删去的鲍比·菲什对蒂莫西·撒切尔比赛。

en.s: General elections were held in Samoa on 29 August 2025 to determine the composition of the 18th Parliament. Initially expected to be held in 2026, Prime Minister Fiamē Naomi Mataʻafa called a snap election after parliament voted down the government budget on 27 May 2025.

en.s: A Scottish Greens co-leadership election occurred in the summer of 2025, and Gillian Mackay and Ross Greer were elected as co-leaders. Of the incumbent co-leaders, Lorna Slater failed in her bid for re-election, while Patrick Harvie stood down. Harvie had announced his intention to step down as co-leader on 2 April 2025, but said he would remain in the post until the next scheduled election in the summer.

zh.t: 2025年苏格兰绿党联合领袖选举
zh.s: 2025年夏季举行了苏格兰绿党联合领袖选举，吉莉安·麦凯和罗斯·格里尔当选联合领袖。原任联合领袖中，洛娜·斯莱特竞选连任失败，帕特里克·哈维则主动卸任。哈维于2025年4月2日宣布打算辞去联合领袖职务，但表示会留任至夏季按计划举行下一次选举。
